validity.researcher_notes: Row's ONLY two harvested gem.wiki citations both fail to support this specific pipeline. (1) gazprommap.ru/pskovskaya/ (the 2021-2025 Pskov gasification programme map, fetched live, 200, read in full/parsed all 31 listed programme objects) does list ГРС «Новоржев» and ГРС «Пушкинские Горы» as EXISTING gas-supply points, but only as the origin of LOCAL distribution spurs to nearby villages: 'Газопровод межпоселковый ГРС «Новоржев» – г. Новоржев' (done=1, already built) and 'от ГРС «Новоржев» – д. Вехно' (done=0), and 'ГРС «Пушкинские Горы» – р.п. Красногородск' (done=0). Nowhere does the page describe a pipeline connecting the two ГРС to EACH OTHER, and 'Бежаницы' (P4149's start point) does not appear anywhere on the page at all -- so the programme table does not, in fact, state the three-row Бежаницы-Новоржев-Пушкинские Горы-Опочка chain the batch brief describes. (2) The federal territorial-planning decree (Распоряжение Правительства РФ от 06.05.2015 N 816-р, read in full via legalacts.ru mirror, 200, searched for Новоржев/Пушкинск/Псков) contains exactly one Pskov Oblast entry -- item 369, 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС Гдов Псковской области' -- and nothing for Novorzhev or Pushkinskiye Gory. Independent web search for corroboration was attempted extensively (WebSearch tool exhausted its session budget; DuckDuckGo, Bing, Yandex, Mojeek, Brave and Marginalia all returned bot-challenge pages or JS-rendered shells that curl could not read; pskov.ru is blocked from this host; pskovgaz.ru is an unbuilt parked domain; novrn.pskovregion.org (Novorzhevsky district site) returned 410 Gone; Novorzhevsky-district Russian Wikipedia article has no gas-infrastructure section) and found nothing further. So: the only two documents this row cites do not name it, and no independent source could be located despite a real search effort. This does not prove the pipeline is fictitious -- both ГРС stations clearly exist and are gasified from somewhere -- but nothing found states a Novorzhev-to-Pushkinskiye-Gory pipe specifically, as opposed to two independently-fed ГРС stations that GEM's naming convention paired into one row. Flagging for a human check against the current (2026) Pskov gasification programme edition or Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Pskov, which this pass could not reach.
